verdict.rationale: dlt is open-source, loads data into open formats/destinations (DuckDB, Parquet, CSV, JSONL, filesystem, standard SQL databases) and is fully code-based with no proprietary lock-in — data can be queried via SQL/Python/Ibis and moved to any destination without vendor lock-in, and switching destinations requires no pipeline code changes. missing for 10: no explicit 'export/leave' migration doc walking through bulk-exiting a dlt-managed dataset, and no independent audit confirming zero lock-in beyond vendor docs/community praise.
